goal: Find the exact algorithm that clinical PCCT (Siemens NAEOTOM Alpha) uses to produce VMI from threshold bin data, such that noise DECREASES with increasing keV and HU accuracy is maintained

topics.title: Audit Current BasisSimulator VMI Implementation
topics.description: Read the current VMI code in verification/notebooks/07_siemens_naeotom_alpha_clinical.jl. Document: (1) how bins are combined into low/high, (2) the polynomial calibration, (3) VMI sinogram synthesis formula, (4) FBP reconstruction. Also read the nb06 dual-energy VMI for comparison. Key fact: material decomposition produces CORRECT HU values but noise is 5-19x worse than clinical. Noiseless VMI is perfect. The problem is purely in how noise propagates through the algorithm.
topics.findings: Three compounding problems: (1) 4->2 bin collapsing discards noise-opt DOF, (2) sinogram-domain 4th-order polynomial amplifies noise catastrophically, (3) FBP ramp filter further amplifies noisy material sinograms. Both nb06 and nb07 use identical algorithm; GE works better due to 80/140 kVp spectral separation.

topics.title: Why Clinical VMI Noise Decreases 40->140 keV
topics.description: Clinical NAEOTOM Alpha VMI FBP noise: 40keV=56.4, 70keV=35.2, 100keV=32.5, 140keV=31.8 HU. Our simulated: 40keV=1063, 70keV=124, 100keV=201, 140keV=297. Clinical noise DECREASES monotonically. Ours increases away from 70 keV. Find the physical/algorithmic explanation.
sources: Leng S et al., Med Phys 2011;38(9):4946-57
Yu L, Leng S, McCollough CH, AJR 2012;199:S9-S15
Yang et al., Med Phys 2025, doi:10.1002/mp.17489
Roessl E, Herrmann C, Phys Med Biol 2009;54(5):1307-18
topics.findings: CMV (constrained minimum-variance) bin weighting explains the pattern. With K>M bins, extra DOF enable noise below poly FBP. At high keV, target attenuation values converge -> easy constraint -> low noise. Anti-correlated PCCT noise provides additional cancellation.

topics.title: Exact Siemens NAEOTOM VMI Algorithm
topics.description: Find the EXACT algorithm Siemens uses.
sources: Grant KL et al., Invest Radiol 2014;49(9):586-92
topics.findings: Siemens patent US7856134B2 confirms image-domain approach with pre-computed weight LUTs. Mono+ (Grant et al. 2014, Siemens co-authors) is built into clinical VMI. Clinical NAEOTOM uses 2 thresholds (not 4) in standard mode. No fundamentally different PCD-CT algorithm vs DECT — same Mono+ with better spectral data.

topics.title: Find Reference VMI Implementations
topics.description: Search GitHub, arxiv, SPIE proceedings for any open-source PCCT VMI implementation.
topics.findings: No open-source CMV VMI implementation found. Closest: spectral_ct_examples uses CRLB-based preconditioning. SPRAY uses regularized decomposition. No end-to-end PCCT VMI pipeline reproducing clinical noise levels publicly available. Mono+ filter specifics remain proprietary.

topics.title: Synthesize Findings into Implementation Spec
topics.description: Based on VMI-001 through VMI-003, write the exact algorithm to implement in BasisSimulator.jl. Include: equations, code pseudocode, expected noise levels, and citations.
